exposure: Uterine fibroid characteristics (type, location, number, size)
Cesarean myomectomy group vs. cesarean section only group
cohort: Pregnant women with uterine fibroids undergoing cesarean section
finding: Myomectomy during cesarean section was found to be safe and feasible in experienced hands, with no significant differences in outcomes compared to cesarean section alone, but large fibroids and high birth weight increased the risk of postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Cesarean myomectomy was found to be safe and feasible based on the estimation by experienced obstetricians.
